name: Passing Judgement
overview: Scripture warns believers against hypocritical or superficial judgment, emphasizing in Matthew 7:1 that we should not judge others lest we be judged ourselves. John 7:24 instructs us to exercise righteous judgment rather than judging by outward appearances. James 4:11 cautions against speaking evil or judging others, highlighting that such behavior contradicts God's law. Instead, believers are called to repentance and transformation (Acts 3:19) and to avoid those who cause divisions contrary to sound doctrine (Romans 16:17). The power of the tongue to defile and cause harm (James 3:6) further underscores the need for careful, godly discernment rather than rash condemnation.
